description: The existence of two Crichtons splits the crew's emotional center as Talyn and Moya follow separate paths, while wormhole knowledge, Scorpius and the Peacekeeper command carrier drive the season toward enormous sacrifice.

s03e01.description: On the ice planet, the crew races to save Aeryn and remove Scorpius's neural technology while a freed Scarran turns the medical station into a battleground.

s03e02.description: A storm batters the commerce station where Moya has docked, while D'Argo, Chiana and Jothee's tangled relationships finally erupt.

s03e03.description: Moya collides with another ship inside a wormhole and becomes fused to it, creating a brutal choice over which vessel can survive.

s03e04.description: Sabotage and mistrust threaten the attempt to separate the fused ships, while Crichton receives an unexpected transmission that appears to come from Earth.

s03e05.description: A visit to a Peacekeeper memorial throws part of the crew into the past, where every attempt to repair history creates another dangerous change.

s03e06.description: Crichton lands on a dying Leviathan inhabited by cannibals and a scientist whose cloning experiments leave Moya with two indistinguishable Crichtons.

s03e07.description: Moya and the damaged Talyn reunite, leaving the crew to cope with two Crichtons while searching a nearby world for medicine to save Talyn.

s03e08.description: Talyn is swallowed by a giant space creature, trapping Crichton, Aeryn and Crais together as jealousy and old grievances complicate the escape.

s03e09.description: Strange energy beings possess members of Moya's crew while Crichton continues pushing his understanding of wormholes beyond safe limits.

s03e10.description: Aeryn's mother Xhalax tracks Talyn down, forcing Aeryn to confront the woman who once chose Peacekeeper duty over her child.

s03e11.description: Scorpius recounts his brutal childhood and obsession with wormhole technology while trying to persuade the neural copy of Crichton to cooperate.

s03e12.description: Talyn is pulled toward a star by an irresistible force, trapping Crichton and Aeryn in an increasingly intimate and dangerous descent.

s03e13.description: Crichton tells Pilot how a stop on a pleasure planet ended with Chiana and Jool kidnapped for a grotesque biological harvesting scheme.

s03e14.description: An Ancient connected to Crichton's wormhole knowledge returns as Scorpius closes in, forcing one of the two Crichtons toward a decisive confrontation.

s03e15.description: Crichton uses newly unlocked wormhole knowledge against Scorpius's forces, but the victory comes at a catastrophic personal cost.

s03e16.description: After D'Argo accidentally incapacitates him, Crichton experiences a violent cartoon fantasy while the others deal with the very real consequences outside his head.

s03e17.description: Aeryn retreats to a remote world after Crichton's death, where grief, prophecy and Xhalax's arrival force her to decide what remains of her old life.

s03e18.description: Moya takes aboard escaped Peacekeeper prisoners just as the separated crews reunite, but evidence of a spy makes the homecoming dangerously unstable.

s03e19.description: D'Argo and Scorpius meet under enforced neural restraint to negotiate, only to be trapped together when criminals interrupt the exchange.

s03e20.description: The crew infiltrates Scorpius's command carrier and begins a covert plan to destroy the wormhole project from inside.

s03e21.description: The sabotage reaches its final stage as Crais and Talyn make a devastating sacrifice to destroy the command carrier and Scorpius's research.

s03e22.description: With the immediate war over, Crichton and Aeryn confront what their losses have done to them while Moya faces another strange threat in space.
